sources.title: MarianMT — transformers 4.2.0 documentation - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: All model names use the following format: Helsinki-NLP/opus-mt- {src}- {tgt}: If a model can output multiple languages, and you should specify a language code by prepending the desired output language to the src_text. You can see a models's supported language codes in its model card, under target constituents, like in opus-mt-en-roa.

sources.title: Marian :: Home
sources.snippet: Marian is an efficient, free Neural Machine Translation framework written in pure C++ with minimal dependencies. It is mainly being developed by the Microsoft Translator team.
